test_title: PYST 2: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

The turtle can live in water __as well as land.__
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'As well as on land'.**
